name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: A strip of triggers where one is current, with an animated indicator. The indicator uses the primitive's CSS variables (--active-tab-*), not React measurement — it tracks on resize and under RTL automatically. Orientation is behaviour from the primitive. Focus ring is palette-ring; the active state is a role (bg-palette-soft), not a colour. No navigation family — tabs and navigation-menu share state normalisation (highlighted) but not enough structural style. The negative result is in the port report.
